text: inside of the cart/editor when an outliner is selected there is the ability to click on a different outliner that is on the stage and it will focus it. I keep having this be a problem at the worst times, and so that behavior should live behinnd a toggle between the ability to click other outliners to focus them vs not being able to from the stage
resolution: Added the Outliner stage-focus lock. It is locked by default (closed-lock button in the Outliner header): native viewport clicks cannot focus another part, while row selection continues to work. Open-lock re-enables existing stage click-to-focus behavior. The guard sits at AppFrame's native __meshEditFocusPart boundary, so stage picks cannot bypass it. Editor bundle succeeds and native ReleaseFast link is in progress under the shared build lock; visual verification needed.
